Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
  | expr_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e)
  | expr_rcd_nil :
     expr exp_rcd_nil
  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     rt_expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e)
  | value_rcd_nil:
      value exp_rcd_nil
 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_tapp : forall e1 e1' V,
      type V ->
      step e1 e1' ->
      step (exp_tapp e1 V) (exp_tapp e1' V)
 | step_tabs : forall T1 e1 T2,
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e')
 | step_projrcd: forall e i vi ,
     value e ->
     tlookup i e = Some vi->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e i) vi
 | step_proj: forall e1 e2 i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e1 i) (exp_rcd_proj e2 i)
 | step_rcd_head: forall e1 e2 e i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e) (exp_rcd_cons i e2 e)
 | step_rcd_cons: forall v1 e1 e2 i,
     value v1 ->
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)
.

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)

  end.

  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

  match b with bind_sub T | bind_typ T => T end.

Fixpoint sub_lookup (E : env) (x : atom) : option typ :=
  match E with
  | [] => None
  | (y,b) :: F =>
      if x == y then
        match b with bind_sub T => Some T | bind_typ _ => None end
      else sub_lookup F x
  end.

Lemma sub_lookup_binds E x T :
  sub_lookup E x = Some T -> binds x (bind_sub T) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; simpl; try discriminate.
  destruct (x == y) as [->|N].
  - destruct b; intro H; inversion H; subst; apply binds_head.
  - intro H; apply binds_cons, IH, H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_sub_lookup E x T :
  uniq E -> binds x (bind_sub T) E -> sub_lookup E x = Some T.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; intros U H.
  - inversion H.
  - apply binds_cons_uniq_iff in H as [[-> [-> _]]|[H N]]; auto.
    + simpl. destruct (y == y); congruence.
    + simpl. destruct (x == y); [congruence|].
      apply IH; [inversion U; auto|assumption].
Qed.

Fixpoint names (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_fvar x => {{x}}
  | typ_arrow A B | typ_all A B => names A "'`union` names B
  | typ_mu A => names A
  | typ_label x A => {{x}} `union` names A
  | typ_rcd_cons x A B => {{x}} `union` (names A `union` names B)
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint env_names (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | [] => {}
  | (x,b) :: F => {{x}} `union` (names (bind_type b) `union` env_names F)
  end.

Lemma dom_env_names E : dom E [<=] env_names E.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[x b] E IH]; simpl; intros y H.
  - fsetdec.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.union_1 H); [fsetdec|].
    specialize (IH _ H0); fsetdec.
Qed.

Definition is_record (T : typ) : bool :=
  match T with typ_rcd_nil | typ_rcd_cons _ _ _ => true | _ => false end.

Lemma is_record_spec T : is_record T = true <-> rt_type T.
Proof. split; [destruct T; simpl; try discriminate; constructor|destruct 1; reflexivity]. Qed.

Definition has_sub E x :=
  match sub_lookup E x with Some _ => true | None => false end.

Fixpoint valid (d : nat) (free : atom -> bool) (T : typ) : bool :=
  match T with
  | typ_bvar n => Nat.ltb n d
  | typ_fvar x => free x
  | typ_arrow A B => valid d free A && valid d free B
  | typ_all A B => valid d free A && valid (S d) free B
  | typ_mu A => valid (S d) free A
  | typ_label _ A => valid d free A
  | typ_rcd_cons x A B =>
      valid d free A && valid d free B && is_record B &&
        negb (AtomSetImpl.mem x (collectLabel B))
  | _ => true
  end.

  if y == x then true else free y.

Lemma has_sub_cons E x U y :
  has_sub ((x,bind_sub U)::E) y = add_var (has_sub E) x y.
Proof. unfold has_sub, add_var; simpl; destruct (y == x); reflexivity. Qed.

  valid d f T = valid d g T.

    try (rewrite IHT; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec]).

  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in V as [V1 V2].
    apply Bool.andb_true_iff; split; eauto with arith.
  - eauto with arith.
  - eauto.
  - repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in *. intuition eauto.

  is_record U = false ->
  is_record (open_tt_rec k U T) = is_record T.

  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec..].
  - apply IHT; exact H.
  - apply IHT; intros; apply H; fsetdec.

Proof.
  intros H; induction H; intro U; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - unfold has_sub. rewrite (binds_sub_lookup U H); reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHW F.

(* A variable is charged for promoting to its bound. The recursive case
   charges for comparing the unfolded bodies, with a single labeled copy
   whose recursive variable is bounded by Top. *)
Definition push (v : nat) (s : nat -> nat) (i : nat) :=
  match i with 0 => v | S j => s j end.

Fixpoint cost (w : atom -> nat) (s : nat -> nat) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_bvar i => s i
  | typ_fvar x => w x
  | typ_arrow A B => S (Nat.max (cost w s A) (cost w s B))
  | typ_all A B =>
      let a := cost w s A in
      S (Nat.max a (cost w (push (S a) s) B))
  | typ_mu A =>
      S (cost w (push (S (cost w (push 2 s) A)) s) A)
  | typ_label _ A => S (cost w s A)
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => Nat.max (S (cost w s A)) (cost w s B)
  | _ => 1
  end.

Definition zero_slots (_ : nat) := 0.
Definition weight w T := cost w zero_slots T.

Definition set_weight (w : atom -> nat) (x : atom) (v : nat) (y : atom) :=
  if y == x then v else w y.

Lemma cost_scoped T w s t d f :
  valid d f T = true ->
  (forall i, i < d -> s i = t i) ->
  cost w s T = cost w t T.
Proof.
  revert s t d. induction T; simpl; intros s t d V H; try reflexivity.
  - apply H, Nat.ltb_lt, V.
  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in V as [VA VB].
    now rewrite (IHT1 _ _ _ VA H), (IHT2 _ _ _ VB H).
  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in V as [VA VB].
    rewrite (IHT1 _ _ _ VA H).
    rewrite (IHT2 _ _ _ VB); [reflexivity|].
    intros [|i] Hi; simpl; auto with arith.
  - assert (P : forall v i, i < S d -> push v s i = push v t i).
    { intros v [|i] Hi; simpl; auto with arith. }
    rewrite (IHT _ _ _ V (P 2)).
    rewrite (IHT _ _ _ V (P _)); reflexivity.
  - now rewrite (IHT _ _ _ V H).
  - repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in V.
    destruct V as [[[VA VB] _] _].
    now rewrite (IHT1 _ _ _ VA H), (IHT2 _ _ _ VB H).
Qed.

Lemma cost_closed T f w s :
  valid 0 f T = true -> cost w s T = weight w T.
Proof. intro V; eapply cost_scoped; [exact V|intros; lia]. Qed.

Lemma cost_open T U f g v k s t :
  (forall x, x "'`in` names T -> f x = g x) ->
  (forall r, cost g r U = v) ->
  (forall i, t i = if k === i then v else s i) ->
  cost g s (open_tt_rec k U T) = cost f t T.
Proof.
  intros F V. revert k s t. induction T; simpl; intros k s t H; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite H. destruct (k === n); auto.
  - symmetry; apply F; fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1 with (t := t), IHT2 with (t := t); auto; intros; apply F; fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1 with (t := t); auto; [|intros; apply F; fsetdec].
    rewrite IHT2 with (t := push (S (cost f t T1)) t); auto.
    + intros; apply F; fsetdec.
    + intros [|i]; simpl; auto.
      change (t i = if k === i then v else s i). apply H.
  - assert (P : forall a i, push a t i = if S k === i then v else push a s i).
    { intros a [|i]; [reflexivity|].
      change (t i = if k === i then v else s i). apply H. }
    rewrite IHT with (t := push 2 t) by auto.
    rewrite IHT with (t := push (S (cost f (push 2 t) T)) t) by auto.
    reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT with (t := t); auto; intros; apply F; fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1 with (t := t), IHT2 with (t := t); auto; intros; apply F; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma weight_open_var T w x v :
  x `notin` names T ->
  weight (set_weight w x v) (open_tt T x) = cost w (push v zero_slots) T.
Proof.
  intro N. unfold weight, open_tt.
  apply cost_open with (v := v).
  - intros y H. unfold set_weight; destruct (y == x); subst; [contradiction|reflexivity].
  - intro; simpl; unfold set_weight. destruct (x == x); congruence.
  - intros [|i]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma weight_open_rec T w x :
  x `notin` names T ->
  valid 0 (fun _ => true) (open_tt T x) = true ->
  weight (set_weight w x 2) (open_tt T (typ_label x (open_tt T x))) =
    cost w (push (S (cost w (push 2 zero_slots) T)) zero_slots) T.
Proof.
  intros N V. unfold weight at 1; unfold open_tt at 1.
  apply cost_open with (v := S (cost w (push 2 zero_slots) T)).
  - intros y H. unfold set_weight; destruct (y == x); subst; [contradiction|reflexivity].
  - intro r; simpl. rewrite (@cost_closed (open_tt T x) _ _ r V).
    now rewrite weight_open_var.
  - intros [|i]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma valid_allow_all T d f :
  valid d f T = true -> valid d (fun _ => true) T = true.
Proof.
  revert d. induction T; simpl; intros d H; auto.
  all: repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in *; intuition eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_open_rec_valid E T x :
  x `notin` names T ->
  valid 1 (has_sub E) T = true ->
  valid 0 (has_sub ((x,bind_sub typ_top)::E))
    (open_tt T (typ_label x (open_tt T x))) = true.
Proof.
  intros N H. pose proof (@valid_open_var E typ_top T x N) as V.
  unfold open_tt at 1. rewrite valid_open with (f := has_sub E); auto.
  - now simpl; rewrite V.
  - intros y Hy. rewrite has_sub_cons. unfold add_var.
    destruct (y == x); subst; [contradiction|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma set_weight_const x : forall y,
  set_weight (fun _ => 2) x 2 y = 2.
Proof. intro y; unfold set_weight; destruct (y == x); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cost_ext_weight T w w'"' s :
  (forall x, w x = w' x) -> cost w s T = cost w' s T.
Proof.
  revert s. induction T; intro s; intro H; simpl; try reflexivity; auto;
    repeat rewrite IHT1; repeat rewrite IHT2; repeat rewrite IHT; auto.
Qed.

Lemma valid_WF E T : valid 0 (has_sub E) T = true -> WF E T.
Proof.
  remember (weight (fun _ => 2) T) as n eqn:M.
  revert E T M.
  induction n using lt_wf_ind; intros E T M V.
  assert (IH : forall U F, weight (fun _ => 2) U < n ->
                valid 0 (has_sub F) U = true -> WF F U).
  { intros. eapply H; eauto. }

(* A variable is charged for promoting to its bound. The recursive case
   charges for comparing the unfolded bodies, with a single labeled copy
   whose recursive variable is bounded by Top. *)
Definition push (v : nat) (s : nat -> nat) (i : nat) :=
  match i with 0 => v | S j => s j end.

Fixpoint cost (w : atom -> nat) (s : nat -> nat) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_bvar i => s i
  | typ_fvar x => w x
  | typ_arrow A B => S (Nat.max (cost w s A) (cost w s B))
  | typ_all A B =>
      let a := cost w s A in
      S (Nat.max a (cost w (push (S a) s) B))
  | typ_mu A =>
      S (cost w (push (S (cost w (push 2 s) A)) s) A)
  | typ_label _ A => S (cost w s A)
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => Nat.max (S (cost w s A)) (cost w s B)
  | _ => 1
  end.

Definition zero_slots (_ : nat) := 0.
Definition weight w T := cost w zero_slots T.

Definition set_weight (w : atom -> nat) (x : atom) (v : nat) (y : atom) :=

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >> Task.v <<'EOF'

(* Swapping two fresh atoms transports a binder premise to any other
   fresh choice, including the labels introduced by recursive opening. *)
Fixpoint rename (p : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_fvar x => typ_fvar (p x)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (rename p A) (rename p B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (rename p A) (rename p B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (rename p A)
  | typ_label x A => typ_label (p x) (rename p A)
  | typ_rcd_cons x A B => typ_rcd_cons (p x) (rename p A) (rename p B)
  | _ => T
  end.

Definition rename_binding p b :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (rename p T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (rename p T)
  end.

Definition rename_env p (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun xb => (p (fst xb), rename_binding p (snd xb))) E.

Lemma rename_id p T :
  (forall x, x "'`in` names T -> p x = x) ->
  rename p T = T.
Proof.
  induction T; simpl; intro H; try reflexivity; f_equal;

        * right; now apply IH.

Fixpoint rename (p : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_fvar x => typ_fvar (p x)

Lemma sub_wf_env E A B : sub E A B -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x N].
    specialize (H4 x N). inversion H4; assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x N].
    specialize (H2 x N). inversion H2; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_bound_lookup E x T :
  wf_env E -> sub_lookup E x = Some T ->
  WF E (typ_fvar x).
Proof. intros; eapply WF_var, sub_lookup_binds; eauto. Qed.

Fixpoint env_weight (E : env) : atom -> nat :=
  match E with
  | [] => fun _ => 1
  | (x,b) :: F =>
      let w := env_weight F in
      match b with
      | bind_sub T => set_weight w x (S (weight w T))
      | bind_typ _ => w
      end
  end.

Lemma cost_free_ext T w w' s :
  (forall x, x "'`in` names T -> w x = w'"' x) -> cost w s T = cost w' s T.
Proof.
  revert s. induction T; simpl; intros s H; try reflexivity.
  - apply H; fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec..].
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec..].
  - rewrite (IHT (push 2 s) H), IHT by exact H; reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec].
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; [reflexivity|intros; apply H; fsetdec..].
Qed.

(* The cost of a closed-over-environment bound is unchanged by a new
   binding whose key was absent. *)
Lemma cost_valid_ext T d f w w' s :
  valid d f T = true ->
  (forall x, f x = true -> w x = w' x) ->
  cost w s T = cost w' s T.
Proof.
  revert d s. induction T; simpl; intros d s V H; try reflexivity; auto.
  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in V as [VA VB].
    now rewrite (IHT1 _ _ VA H), (IHT2 _ _ VB H).
  - apply Bool.andb_true_iff in V as [VA VB].
    now rewrite (IHT1 _ _ VA H), (IHT2 _ _ VB H).
  - now rewrite (IHT _ (push 2 s) V H), (IHT _ _ V H).
  - repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in V.
    destruct V as [[[VA VB] _] _].
    now rewrite (IHT1 _ _ VA H), (IHT2 _ _ VB H).
Qed.

Lemma has_sub_dom E x : has_sub E x = true -> x "'`in` dom E.
Proof.
  unfold has_sub. destruct (sub_lookup E x) eqn:L; try discriminate.
  intros _. eapply binds_In, sub_lookup_binds; eauto.
Qed.

Definition all_support E S A B :=
  env_names E "'`union` (names S `union` (names A `union` names B)).

Definition rec_support E A B :=
  env_names E `union` (names A `union` names B).

Lemma support_dom E x : x `notin` env_names E -> x `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros N D; apply N, dom_env_names, D. Qed.

Lemma sub_top_source E A : sub E A typ_top -> WF E A.
Proof. intro D; invert_sub D; eauto using WF_var. Qed.

Lemma sub_var_inv E x B :
  B <> typ_top -> sub E (typ_fvar x) B ->
  exists U, binds x (bind_sub U) E /'"\\ (B = typ_fvar x \\/ sub E U B).
Proof.
  intros N D; invert_sub D; try contradiction; eauto.
  match goal with H : WF E (typ_fvar x) |- _ => inversion H; subst; eauto end.
Qed.

Lemma sub_all_bound_WF E S1 S2 A B :
  sub E (typ_all S1 A) (typ_all S2 B) -> WF E S2.
Proof.
  intro D; apply sub_all_inv in D as [_ [_ [L H]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x N].
  pose proof (sub_wf_env (H x N)) as W. inversion W; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_all_at E S1 S2 A B x :
  x "'`notin` all_support E S2 A B ->
  sub E (typ_all S1 A) (typ_all S2 B) ->
  sub ((x,bind_sub S2)::E) (open_tt A x) (open_tt B x).
Proof.
  intros NX D. apply sub_all_inv in D as [_ [_ [L H]]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` all_support E S2 A B)) as [y NY].
  eapply all_body_transport with (x := y); unfold all_support in *; auto.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma sub_rec_valid E A B :
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  valid 1 (has_sub E) A = true /'"\\ valid 1 (has_sub E) B = true.
Proof.
  intro D. apply sub_rec_inv in D as [L H].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L "'`union` rec_support E A B)) as [x N].
  assert (NL : x `notin` L) by fsetdec.
  destruct (H x NL) as [VA [VB DX]].
  pose proof (wf_env_uniq (sub_wf_env DX)) as Uq.
  unfold rec_support in N.
  split.
  - rewrite <- (@valid_open_var E typ_top A x) by fsetdec. exact (WF_valid VA Uq).
  - rewrite <- (@valid_open_var E typ_top B x) by fsetdec. exact (WF_valid VB Uq).
Qed.

Lemma sub_rec_at E A B x :
  x `notin` rec_support E A B ->
  sub E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B) ->
  sub ((x,bind_sub typ_top)::E) (open_rec_body A x) (open_rec_body B x).
Proof.
  intros NX D. apply sub_rec_inv in D as [L H].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` rec_support E A B)) as [y NY].
  eapply rec_body_transport with (x := y); unfold rec_support in *; auto.
  - fsetdec.
  - assert (NL : y `notin` L) by fsetdec.
    exact (proj2 (proj2 (H y NL))).
Qed.

Lemma lookup_weight_less T U x w :
  Tlookup x T = Some U -> weight w U < weight w T.
Proof.
  unfold weight. induction T; simpl; try discriminate.
  destruct (a == x).
  - intro H; inversion H; subst; lia.
  - intro H; specialize (IHT2 H); lia.
Qed.

Definition pair_weight E A B :=
  weight (env_weight E) A + weight (env_weight E) B.

Lemma all_body_decreases E S1 A S2 B x :
  x `notin` all_support E S2 A B ->
  sub E S1 S2 -> sub E S2 S1 ->
  pair_weight ((x,bind_sub S2)::E) (open_tt A x) (open_tt B x) <
  pair_weight E (typ_all S1 A) (typ_all S2 B).
Proof.
  intros N D R. unfold all_support in N.
  pose proof (@mutual_weight E E S1 S2 D eq_refl R (env_weight E)) as Eq.
  unfold pair_weight. cbn [env_weight].
  rewrite !weight_open_var by fsetdec.
  unfold weight in *; cbn [cost]. rewrite Eq; lia.
Qed.

Lemma rec_body_decreases E A B x :
  x `notin` rec_support E A B ->
  valid 1 (has_sub E) A = true -> valid 1 (has_sub E) B = true ->
  pair_weight ((x,bind_sub typ_top)::E) (open_rec_body A x) (open_rec_body B x) <
  pair_weight E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B).
Proof.

Fixpoint decide_on_list {X : Type} (P : X -> Prop)

    {sub E U V} + {~ sub E U V}) i :
  {field_ok E A B i} + {~ field_ok E A B i}.

  destruct (Tlookup i A) as [U|] eqn:LA, (Tlookup i B) as [V|] eqn:LB;

    {sub E U V} + {~ sub E U V}) :

Proof.
  destruct (WF_dec A (wf_env_uniq W)) as [VA|NA].
  2: { right; intro D; apply NA, (proj1 (proj2 (sub_record_inv RA RB D))). }
  destruct (WF_dec B (wf_env_uniq W)) as [VB|NB].
  2: { right; intro D; apply NB, (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (sub_record_inv RA RB D)))). }

  2: { right; intro D. apply (proj1 (sub_record_inv RA RB D)), AtomSetImpl.subset_1 in D.
